own_solution.law: Successive closed-pipe resonant lengths differ by lambda/2 = c/(2f); t = (lambda/2)/vw

defect_reasons.other: The C cancellation names the 13 lam/4 and 15 lam/4 resonances as 'the' successive pair, but for an initial length of 85 or 130 cm earlier resonances (7 lam/4 = 117 cm, 9 lam/4 = 151 cm, minus e) come first; the spacing and the invariance are unaffected.
